purpose: Decide whether a source observation or generated design asset can be reused at a component, scenario, page or global scope.
procedure: Classify subject as token, asset, component or composition; never infer approval from appearance on an official site.
Record the source's purpose, page, region, state and provenance; distinguish observation from interpretation.
Compare relevant pages and states in the same role; list missing and conflicting evidence.
Run subject-specific checks, then grant only the narrowest supported scope.
Require named design approval and independent visual validation before reusable application; retain rejected or blocked decisions as negative cases.
notFor: automatically approving a source color from its frequency or pixel value
treating generated images or demo screenshots as source assets
replacing independent visual QA with a complete JSON record
readerPurpose: 执行判断的步骤与取舍
